# References {.unnumbered}

Each chapter lists the works it cites at the bottom of its own page; the
complete bibliography lives in `references.bib` in the book repository. The list
below is deliberately wider than the set of works cited in the text: it prints
every entry in the bibliography, so it doubles as further reading. A work
appearing here is therefore not evidence that a particular claim in the book
rests on it --- for that, follow the citations in the chapters themselves. The main background references are Imbens and
Rubin [-@imbens-rubin-2015] and Hernán and Robins [-@hernan-robins-2020].
